purpose: One diagnostic Debug original-long notified strict capture, after bounded self-tests. No throughput fix or universal qualification claimed from instrumentation alone.

parameters.REPO: Exact clean frozen source plus fixed miniaudio/Ogg/Opus pins
parameters.OUTPUT: New guard output directory outside source
parameters.ELF: Unique actual Debug semantic_live_process_test produced by this frozen build, pin full SHA256 and size before native invocation
parameters.TAPE_DIRECTORY: Exclusively created new absolute non-symlink empty directory outside source

sequence.expected: Generate only sixteen original authored input WAVs from existing fixed generator; verify every existing SHA, never overwrite mismatch.
New profile unit tests, streaming compatibility, process self-tests and production compile. Native workload skips with mode unset. Any real failure stops dependent capture and remains evidence.
Exactly one actual recording attempt; preserve success or failure, no timing reroll. Full native cleanup and diagnostic integrity are inspected separately from exit status.

preconditions: Independent static review closed before publication; exact source and plan saved/read back before first build.

Native stage only after focused success and its separate result saved. Same frozen tree and pinned Debug ELF; no other SME variables or controlled hook, delay, fault injection, safety gain or hardware mode.
Create empty tape directory before invocation; verify unique ELF, dependencies, fixture hashes and source guard. Missing prerequisite is setup failure, never an actual capture attempt.
Fixed 4 MiB and 16384-descriptor lanes, original long >=32768 submitted frames, strict wire4 and finite max_generated_frames/file limits remain unchanged.
measurement_contract: Instrumentation exclusively on test nonRT collector and test raw file adapter; no Audio/producer hook clocks, allocation, locks, logging or pacing changes.
Per-role deterministic 1/64 sampling reports observed coverage, population and clock-call counts; no fixed global stride assumptions or sampled-to-population exact CPU claims.

Stage wall durations are observed elapsed time, include scheduling. Append contains encoding-independent writer hash/buffer/raw work. Raw write time is an inclusive subset for sampled append calls, and includes final flush writes; never sum as disjoint totals. fsync/close excluded from raw time.

Only existing atomic record counters/peaks may be sampled live. Snapshots are not coherent global states. Final non-atomic byte counts only after genuine owner joins/destruction. First collector failure is pinned separately from later cleanup.

Bounded aggregate/timeline storage and explicit overflow/invalid clock indicators. Report attempted/completed/error counts and acknowledged versus requested write bytes. Failed/partial file remains incomplete, not a sealed replay history.

After actual owner cleanup, parse collector-profile.json as JSON; check sample_count <= population, errors/counters, phase/role/family totals and actual stats/cleanup consistency. Missing/truncated/overflowed diagnostics remain a measurement limitation, not a reason to rerun.

bounds.termination: Runner SIGTERM owned process group, up to10 seconds then SIGKILL; timeout never implies clean Host teardown.

outcome: Archive source/plan and sanitized independent results on existing project branches. Do not upload local paths, raw logs, PCM, tape or executable. If a valid sealed/admitted tape exists, freeze a separate same-ELF fresh replay plan; otherwise preserve failure and diagnose a minimal lossless fix before any new recording. No Windows, main, Pause/Resume or device selection changes.
static_review: Independent line-by-line review confirmed unchanged native drain order, original errors and poisoning; production pointer null-only and no producer/Audio edits.
First failure snapshot pinned; timeline freezes on error, full stats only after genuine join; post-join sealing/admission failure still reports diagnostics.
Fixed per-role sampling avoids global stride aliasing; measured coverage and wall-time limits explicit.

Unit tests written for exact enabled/disabled canonical bytes, original observe/encode/append failures, partial file write, sticky errors, JSON roundtrip, retention, explicit overflow and scope rejection. Not executed yet.
